title: Continuous deployment from the branch model
description: The `ci` layer: an OWNED GitHub Actions deploy workflow (.github/workflows/deploy.yml) that, on a push to a PROTECTED line the branch model binds with `ci` (one line per environment), deploys every affected project's `deploy` target (base = the last successful run, via nx-set-shas; workflow_dispatch scope=all, or a line pattern, deploys all) with `-c ci-<environment>` in that line's GitHub environment — each deploy provider's targets carry that configuration, nobody else's. Install runs in a job without id-token; only the deploy job authenticates (Firebase: keyless Workload Identity Federation in a house-owned pool); actions pinned by SHA. Plus each provider's human-run cloud setup (tools/setup-gcp.sh), which records what it creates for an exact rollback. Undeclared model or no binding → no workflow, and says what to do. Never overwrites a file the house did not write, never a second deploy workflow.

layers.description: The layers this run applies — the deploy providers are theirs. Defaults to detecting them.

branchProjection.description: The branch model the caller RESOLVED: its projection as JSON, or 'undeclared'. Passed by house.sh; absent on a direct call, which reads the workspace's .bespunky/branches.json.
